card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Early pieces of longer words that are still unfinished, mostly in medical labels, such as the start of sterilization, hemodialysis, rifampin and isotonic.

modes.label: Hemodialysis and sterility words
modes.description: The middle piece of a split-up word like hemodialysis or the start of sterile and sterilization.

modes.label: Other unfinished words and numbers
modes.description: Pieces of other long words or numbers, such as rifampin, isotonic, or a digit within a day range.
modes.example: Pediatric patients on rif<<amp>>in should receive 70 mg/m

card.writes: The suppressed tokens look like unrelated foreign-language and odd tokens, so there is no clear output effect beyond favoring word endings like 'sed'.
card.plain: It fires when a long medical word has only been partly written, such as hemodialysis or sterilization, and the rest is still to come.
